# How to run tests

To run the workspace tests, run the following command:

```bash
cargo test --workspace
```

To run the court harness, run the following command:

```bash
cargo test -p cgap-court
```

To run the boundary and zero-string gates, run the following command:

```bash
python3 scripts/boundary_gate.py && python3 scripts/zero_string_gate.py
```
